instances.note: owner = deployer; scripted heartbeats. Funded 0.5 lREACT at deploy, +3 and +6 by transfer on 2026-11-15 (9.5 in all). This build predates coverDebt(), and a transfer does not clear system-contract debt, so it stalled in debt after its last logged event (2026-11-08 23:35 UTC) and missed a heartbeat sent on 2026-11-22. Revived 2026-11-22 with depositTo (1 lREACT: 0.0134 debt settled, 0.9866 to reserves); the next heartbeat reacted within ~10 s. Shares owner and tokens with the demo and p1b-e2e instances, so its rows and cost up to costFrom include their activity; the cost window starts after the demo ended.
